newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - NOV 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS - NOV 4.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:
--Athens says 'yes' to US initiative for joint cooperation with the European Union to participate in the reconstruction of Balkan nations.
--President Kiro Gligorov of the Former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia says there is an important role for Greece to play in the Balkans.

--Main opposition New Democracy party takes another step towards chaos as 20 MPs make a public call for bickering high-ranking members to settle their differences. Former prime minister Constantine Mitsotakis denies reports of his resignation.

--Health Minister Costas Geitonas announces wide-ranging planned changes to the national health system. State hospitals to get managers, school doctor and general practitioner systems to be established.

--Last chance for New Democracy as the rank and file exerts strong pressure for a mutually acceptable solution. --A community rallies round a schoolgirl who lost a leg over the weekend in a traffic accident.
--Leading New Democracy cadres prepare to ask leader Miltiades Evert to resign.
